narrative: Pt. took 4 vaccines at once total (3 intramuscular and one oral) at the age of 8 week on May 03rd 2022. By the end of the same month, we started noticing a weird jerking movement (Moro reflex alike) that happens in clusters. This movement was subtle first and became more obvious and dominant. In June, she was diagnosed with infantile spasms. Before the vaccine, she was a healthy baby, hitting her developmental milestones like any normal child. We have done multiple tests to rule out genetic reasons, metabolism, pregnancy issues, delivery issues; all were clear. Looking back, we believe vaccines taken on May 03rd 2022 were the main culprit to her diagnoses; Taking all 4 vaccines at once and, specifically, taking the (DTaP-HBV-POL) which is on the contraindications list for infantile spasm and uncontrolled seizures.  Pt. has relapsed twice. she was treated with Prednisolone (Once for a month in June 2022), ACTH (Twice in August 2022 and December 2022) and currently on Vigabatrin (Starting in July 2022). She is currently in the process to being surgically evaluated.
